example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনে সফল হতে হলে আত্মনং সততং রক্ষেৎ মেনে চলতে হবে।
বিপদের সময় সে আত্মনং সততং রক্ষেৎ করে নিজেকে বাঁচিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: To succeed in life, one must always follow 'atmanam satatam rakshhet'.
In times of danger, he protected himself by adhering to 'atmanam satatam rakshhet'.
history: This Sanskrit proverb originates from ancient Indian texts like the Manusmriti or ethical treatises, emphasizing personal safety and vigilance in Hindu philosophy.
note: This is a classical Sanskrit subhashita (wise saying) incorporated into Bengali linguistic and cultural repertoire through shared Indo-Aryan heritage.
